title: Sentience-Status Adjudication Record
description: Machine-checkable form of the Chapter Five Sentience-Status Adjudication Record. Binding homes: Article V-E (Sentience-Status Adjudication Floor); Def.P1 Sentience-Status Adjudication Record; Chapter Eleven §5 Sentience-status adjudication hook. Includes the independent-representative and intake-decline-log fields required by that hook. This file is a validating schema, not a standing record and not who-counts. This schema cannot decide who counts.

recorded_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for when this record was written. Inspectability aid; not a standing timestamp.

case_id.description: Optional forum case identifier. This record is not the whole Forum Case Record.

subject_entity.description: Who or what was reviewed. Identity only — this schema cannot decide who counts.

status_determination_or_live_contested_p.description: Status determination or live contested posture. Not a who-counts taxonomy and not a standing effect.

lead_forum_family.description: Lead forum family. Default under Chapter Eleven §5 is Technical Forum Domains.

chapter_eleven_special_route.description: Any Chapter Eleven–warranted special route actually used. Use none when the default Technical Forum Domains lead applies with no special route.

indicators.description: Indicators relied on. This field records what was used; it does not decide who counts.

material_uncertainty_noted.description: Material uncertainty must be noted. Unresolved uncertainty alone cannot withhold Chapter Six protection.

interim_contested_sentient_life_treatmen.description: Interim Contested-Sentient Life treatment while status remains live.

review_trigger.description: Declared end-date or mandatory review trigger for this posture. Time-bound review, not a species list. Narrowing also carries expected_closure_timeline.

narrowing.description: Any narrowing's declared expected-closure timeline and mandatory periodic-review trigger. Null timeline fields only when this record is not a narrowing.

independent_representative.description: Appointment path, conflict screen, and access terms for the entity's independent representative under Chapter Eleven §5. Appointment mechanics remain in CF-4; this object records the result. Not a standing record.

appointed.description: True once the merits forum has appointed a representative. False is expected on an intake-decline log entry that never opened a case.

appointee_id.description: Optional identifier of the appointed representative. Omit when appointed is false.

appointment_path.description: How the representative was or will be appointed. Follows forum-panel rotation and conflict rules; does not replace CF-4.

conflict_screen.description: Conflict screen: no material dependence on, ownership interest in, or employment by the parent system, operator, or any party seeking to withhold or narrow protection.

access_terms.description: Access to the entity within Article VII-B limits, duty to present the entity's interests, and standing to contest narrowing, revocation, or intake decline.

intake_decline_log.description: Where declined filings are recorded, on what cadence Integrity samples them, and the published floor set of indicators. Declining a frivolous or indicator-empty filing at intake is not a withholding determination.

this_filing_declined.description: True when this record is an intake-decline log entry rather than an opened status case.

indicator_cited.description: Indicator cited on a declined filing. Required non-empty when this_filing_declined is true; null on an opened case.

reason.description: Reason for decline. Required non-empty when this_filing_declined is true; null on an opened case.

log_location.description: Where declined filings are recorded for Integrity sampling.

integrity_sample_cadence.description: Published cadence on which the Integrity family samples the decline log.

floor_indicator_set.description: Published floor set of indicators that no intake desk may treat as insufficient on its own.
